name: repetitive_sums_benchmark_leaderboard
description: A leaderboard-style benchmark that tests models' ability to reliably compute repetitive addition problems (repeated sums), exposing failures in arithmetic consistency and chain-of-thought scaling. It compares models across input lengths and prompt variants to evaluate numeric correctness and robustness. The focus is on exact numerical output rather than explanatory text.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for researchers focusing on arithmetic reliability and robustness of LLMs; moderate attention within that subcommunity.
